text:
Liam Öhgren has been one of the few things going right in Vancouver, and our numbers have two tags on him at once: breakout and due to cool. He has nine points in 18 games, already half of last season's total, and five goals in his last ten. Daniel Wagner noted after the Winnipeg loss that "at least Liam Öhgren was good."

Some of the breakout is real. He's on the ice for 26% of the Canucks' power-play chances, up from 5%, and his own chances are up to 0.67 expected goals per 60 from 0.47. Wins added ranks him 59th of 504 skaters because his goals have mattered.

Some of it isn't. He has six goals on 2.9 expected, shooting 24% after 9% last season, and his chances over the hot stretch were normal. His ice time has actually dropped by about two and a half minutes a night. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows 53% of his shots come off the rush. Our range has him at 12 to 22 goals over a full season. The role is the part to bet your patience on; the shooting percentage is not.
headline: Öhgren's breakout, with a warning
